text:
mira: noticed multiple tenants getting 401s from /oauth2/introspect after last night's lifecycle ops. Introspect says signature verify failed but IdP reports tokens fine. any ideas?
josh: can you drop the proxy log line? might be a kid/jwks mismatch.
mira: log snippet: 
```
2025-06-12T01:14:02Z introspect[svc]: tenant=pegasus err="verify failed: kid mismatch"
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_token"}
```
rafa: we've also seen SCIM patches for role mappings return 202 then 500 in the same minute. sounds like a short window where key material and jwks disagree. opsbot: kms-operator: rewrap key key-id=k-rewrap-21 completed 2025-06-12T01:13:50Z.
josh: likely race: our services still decrypting old ciphertext while IdP rotated jwks -> new kid used in tokens. quick fixes: 1) pause KMS rewraps, 2) add an accept-old-kid fallback for 30s in introspect to allow previous kid, 3) add SCIM retry with jitter for role apply.
mira: implementing 2) now as a short-term patch. will also pause automated rewraps for next hour.
kms-operator: pause requested by mira (reason: incident mitigation) - id=pause-2150.
security-bot: RBAC audit flagged 8 accounts created without roles between 01:13 and 01:16 UTC (high risk). pls file backfill.
rafa: i'll open tickets: INFRA-2464 (rewrap choreography doc), PLATFORM-3982 (accept-old-kid fallback), SEC-721 (backfill orphaned rbac). also propose adding an Audit rule correlating KMS rotations and provisioning errors.
mira: thanks. followups assigned. will keep thread open until backfill completes. :white_check_mark:
